span.p:
Relocalization Manager 상세 아키텍처
RelocalizationCoordinator + RelocalizationPolicy
현재 YAML 기본값 · 장기 GPS 단절 복구 전용 · fail-closed

div.style: color: rgb(16, 38, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
실행 경계
별도 relocalization 노드가 아님
localization_supervisor_node 안에서 StatusManager·Supervisor와 함께 단일 ros::spin

div.style: color: rgb(16, 38, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1. ROS 입력 callback + cache
GPS gate: candidate_pose · gate_pose · gate_relocalizing · reanchor_accepted
절대/차량: lidar/map_pose · vehicle/twist · global/odometry
Pose / Twist / Odometry는 receipt time과 원본 stamp를 따로 보관

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. 공통 pose 계약 검사
frame=map · stamp≠0 · finite XYZ · 유효 quaternion
XY covariance finite/non-negative
candidate age ≤ 1.0 s · future ≤ 0.10 s
LiDAR/Twist/Global freshness는 receipt age + stamp age 동시 확인

div.style: color: rgb(16, 38, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
정상 gate pose
/mando_localization/internal/gps/gate_pose

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
즉시 승인 GPS pose relay
have_prior_anchor=true
last_gate_pose_receipt=now
cluster·pending 초기화
TRACKING · active=false

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
gate_relocalizing Bool
true → SHORT_RECOVERY · active=true
false → TRACKING · active=false

div.style: color: rgb(61, 46, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. 장기 복구 진입?
quality candidate 수신
이전 승인 anchor 있음
마지막 gate 승인 후 > 2.0 s
reset/reanchor pending 아님

div.style: color: rgb(38, 23, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
아니오
기존 GPS gate·StatusManager 정책 유지
Coordinator가 GPS pose를 우회 생성하지 않음

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
예 · recovery_active=true
후보 stamp는 엄격히 증가
첫 후보 기준 cluster radius ≤ 2.0 m
중복·역행 stamp/불일치 → count=0
branch 전환/cluster 이탈 → 현재 후보부터 count=1

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RelocalizationPolicy · 순수 결정 로직
Observation → RecoveryAction + state + reason
NONE · ACCEPT_WITH_LIDAR · RESET_WITH_GPS
ROS publish/service/cache는 Coordinator 책임

div.style: color: rgb(61, 46, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. fresh + time-aligned LiDAR pair?
enable_lidar=true
LiDAR receipt/stamp age ≤ 0.50 s
GPS↔LiDAR stamp skew ≤ 0.20 s

div.style: color: rgb(61, 46, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: GPS↔LiDAR XY ≤ 5.0 m?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 17, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LIDAR_MISMATCH
count reset · active=true
GPS-only로 우회하지 않음

div.style: color: rgb(61, 46, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
증가 GPS epoch가
2.0 m cluster 안에서
LiDAR와 3회 연속 일치?

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
VALIDATING_LIDAR
추가 pair 대기
GPS 출력 차단

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LIDAR_RECOVERY_READY
Global EKF reset 없음
reanchor handshake로 이동

div.style: color: rgb(61, 46, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
모든 GPS-only 사전조건 만족?
automatic_reset_enabled=true · 기본 false
require_measured_datum → reference.measured=true
fresh Twist age ≤ 0.20 s · |vx| ≤ 0.30 m/s
fresh Global Odom age ≤ 0.20 s

div.style: color: rgb(75, 17, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
조건별 fail-closed 상태
GPS_ONLY_BLOCKED
GPS_ONLY_BLOCKED_DATUM
WAITING_FOR_STATIONARY
WAITING_FOR_GLOBAL_ODOMETRY

div.style: color: rgb(61, 46, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
정지 상태 증가 GPS 후보
2.0 m cluster 안에서 5회 연속?

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
VALIDATING_GPS_ONLY
추가 안정 후보 대기

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5. Global EKF SetPose
/mando_localization/internal/ekf/global_set_pose
service 존재 대기 ≤ 0.30 s
candidate XY/XY covariance 적용
최신 Global Z/yaw/나머지 covariance 유지
동기 call 자체 hard timeout 없음

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
post-reset Global 확인
stamp ≥ reset request · target XY ≤ 2.0 m
fresh + 서로 다른 증가 stamp 3회 연속
timeout 1.0 s · 중간 불일치면 count reset

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GPS_ONLY_RESET_READY
→ WAITING_FOR_GLOBAL_CONFIRMATION
확인 완료 후 reanchor handshake

div.style: color: rgb(75, 17, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SET_POSE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
SET_POSE_CALL_FAILED
GLOBAL_CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT
active=true 유지

div.style: color: rgb(18, 60, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6. 공통 GPS Gate reanchor command
/mando_localization/internal/gps/reanchor_pose
GpsGateReanchor transaction_id + target pose
WAITING_FOR_GPS_GATE_REANCHOR · reanchor_pending=true
Gate 검사: 최신 candidate와 ≤ 2.0 m · stamp gap ≤ 1.0 s · fresh Local Odom
prediction anchor 실제 적용 후에만 ACK

div.style: color: rgb(61, 46, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7. /mando_localization/internal/gps/reanchor_accepted
ACK pose 계약 유효?
transaction_id 정확히 일치
stamp gap ≤ 1e-6 s · XY gap ≤ 1e-6 m
timeout 1.0 s 이내?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 17, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
불일치 ACK: 계속 대기
timeout → GPS_GATE_REANCHOR_TIMEOUT
active=true · GPS pose 계속 차단
timeout 뒤 late/duplicate ACK 무시

div.style: color: rgb(18, 60, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
finishRecovery
/molit/localization/gps/map_pose 발행
승인 GPS pose의 단일 발행자
pending·counter·cluster 초기화
RECOVERED_WITH_LIDAR 또는
RECOVERED_WITH_GPS_RESET · active=false

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
상시 20 Hz timer / watchdog / heartbeat
/molit/localization/recovery/state · String latched
/mando_localization/internal/recovery/active · Bool latched
/mando_localization/internal/gps/relocalizing · Bool latched
Global 확인·reanchor ACK timeout 감시

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
내부 상태
have_prior_anchor · last gate receipt
candidate cluster/count/last stamp
reset_pending + target + Global confirmations
reanchor_pending + transaction + target

div.style: color: rgb(38, 23, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
승인 GPS pose
/molit/localization/gps/map_pose
→ InterfaceAdapter
→ /mando_localization/internal/ekf/gps_pose
→ Global EKF GPS 입력

div.style: color: rgb(38, 23, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LocalizationStatusManager · 같은 process
gps_relocalizing + 승인 GPS pose 관찰
evaluated state / valid 생성

div.style: color: rgb(38, 23, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LocalizationSupervisor · 같은 process
recovery heartbeat age ≤ 0.50 s
active=true → RELOCALIZING, valid=false
heartbeat 누락/stale → FAULT, valid=false

div.style: color: rgb(75, 17, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LocalizationOutputGate · 별도 node
valid=false 또는 stale이면
Global Odom이 있어도 최종
/molit/localization/odometry 차단

div.style: color: rgb(90, 38, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
현재 구현 경계
LiDAR 자체 stamp 증가를 요구하지 않아 fresh/skew 범위에서 같은 pose 재사용 가능
LiDAR 측정의 Global EKF 내부 수용 ACK 없음 · LiDAR 경로는 Global set_pose를 하지 않음
datum은 measured bool만 확인 · mode/source 재검증 없음
SetPose 동기 call hard timeout 없음 · single-thread heartbeat 지연 가능
GPS callback 완전 중단은 Coordinator가 아니라 StatusManager의 DEAD_RECKONING/FAULT 경로
